author: Vior_
body:
Minecraft Username: Vior_


Discord ID: Vior#7403


In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: I am a avicus player who was been on the server for about 4 years. I am a pretty active player and recently have been promoted to referee rank.


What is your Instagram account?: My personal Instagram account is @_lucagaspari . FYI I do not have many posts, just a heads up.


Have you ever marketed something using Instagram before?: I have not.


Do you have experience editing photos?: I have a small amount of experience editing photos in general, but on instagram I have done it quite a bit. I know the basics of photoshop also if this helps.


Do you have experience taking good screenshots in Minecraft?:

Yes. FYI I do not have shaders, but I would download them if taken into this position. Only if this is needed.


What is one weakness you know you have?:

I do not have the experience. I have never been part of a social media team. Also never have edited any other photos than my own. I am willing to learn as much as I can as this poisition. One of my main goals is to grow and expand the avicus community as much as possible, and I am always looking to get more involved in the avicus community. Thanks so much!
